content.value: You are given a computer with following format for floating point representation: 1 (10) [CO1 sign bit, 6 exponent bit(s) and 4 significant bits. However, for a given problem, you require higher precision values without increasing bit numbers. Write down your solution for this problem and its impact on the system.
